from scipy.ndimage import label
def comps_of(I):
    res=[]
    for c in sorted(set(I.flat)-{0,4}):
        cells=np.argwhere(I==c)
        rs=cells[:,0]; cs=cells[:,1]
        r0,c0,r1,c1=rs.min(),cs.min(),rs.max(),cs.max()
        sub=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]==c
        lab,n=label(sub.astype(int)); ncells=sub.sum()
        # enclosed holes: bg regions of mask that don't touch border
        bg=(lab==0).astype(int)==0
        h=n-1
        res.append(dict(c=c,size=ncells,bbox=(r0,c0,r1,c1),holes=h))
    return res

    for i in range(7):
        if i in (0,4): continue

        rs=pts[:,0]; cls=pts[:,1]
        r0=min(rs); c0=min(cls)
        H=max(rs)-r0+1; W=max(cls)-c0+1
        m=(A[r0:r0+H,c0:c0+W]==i).astype(int)

        out.append({'col':int(i),'r0':int(r0),'c0':int(c0),'m':m,'shape':s})

    O=G[k+' output']

    yield v; yield np.fliplr(v); yield np.flipud(v)
    y=np.rot90(np.rot90(v))
    yield y; yield np.fliplr(y); yield np.flipud(y)

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

        col=int(x['col']); s=x['shape']; m=x['m']
        inc=tuple(sorted(map(int,s)))
        if col not in dm: continue
        outc=tuple(dm[col])

        for u in dihed(m):
            sc=tuple(map(int,np.argwhere(u==1)))
            if tuple(sorted(sc))==outc: ok=True; break
        print(' col',col,'in shape:',inc,'out cells:',outc,'matchable:',ok)
